The '''Trax Sector Force''' was the total military assets of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operating in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Under the command of [[Beckar]], the Trax Sector Force consisted of an [[Assault frigate/Legends|assault frigate]], an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Defector]]'', fifteen [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], and two [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigates]], [[Corellian Thunder (DP20 gunship)|''Corellian Thunder'']] and ''[[Dream Runner]]'', and thirty-five [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The main [[Trax Sector Command|sector command]] base was located on [[Entrus]], while starfighter repairs were conducted at a [[Qetix IV Alliance base|base]] in the [[Dresscol system/Legends|Dresscol system]]. [[Capital ship/Legends|Capital ships]] were docked in the [[Ventil system/Legends|Ventil system]].
